title: Heavenly Secrets Manifest
next_chapter_hook: "The words on the fourth page of the Tianji Record have yet to fade, and those eyes that transcend Heavenly Dao have already locked onto him—within seven days, his feigned death identity will be completely exposed."

text.content:
"Inside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, the atmosphere froze solid as ice.

Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master Xuan Pohai sat in the guest seat, his face ashen, his knuckles clicking against the armrest. Several disciples behind him were too terrified to even breathe loudly—the chess match just now, their Sect Master had lost completely, with no chance to turn the tide, all routes blocked in advance by the opponent.

And the mastermind behind all this, the one they called the 'waste servant,' now stood in the corner with head bowed, as if about to be swallowed by the overwhelming pressure of the hall.

But Chen Ji's mind was nowhere near this great hall."

dialogue.content: (Smirking internally) The old fool who can't handle losing, still putting on the Sect Master's airs with a face green as gourd. But... the real trouble was never him.

text.content:
"At that moment, a sharp pain pierced Chen Ji's brow center.

The Tianji Record Fragment blazed fiercely, golden light emerging from his chest, blazing so bright it hurt to look at under everyone's watchful eyes. The entire hall fell silent in an instant, all gazes falling upon that unimaginable radiance.

"What is this!" Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master leapt to his feet, a flash of fear crossing his eyes—he instinctively felt that this power was identical to the 'chess game power' he had sensed just moments ago."

dialogue.content:
(Thinking this is bad, but wearing a look of confusion on his face) Wh-what's happening... I don't know either...

(Pressing hand to chest, feigning panic) Seniors, please save me! Why is there something like this on my body!"

text.content:
"The light from the Tianji Record grew ever brighter, golden characters beginning to materialize around Chen Ji—those were the contents of the fourth page, fragmentary for so long, never before revealed.

At the same time, countless miles away in the depths of a certain ancient ruin, Chen Nian's eyes snapped open.

The stone wall before her also gleamed golden, resonating with the light emanating from Chen Ji, as if an invisible thread tightly bound these separated siblings together."

dialogue.content:
(Trembling all over, tears uncontrollably sliding down) Brother... is that you? You're alive... I knew you were still alive!

(Reaching out to touch the characters on the stone wall, her fingertips burning with pain) These words... I can see them, I can actually see them!"

text.content:
"The fourth page's text finally revealed itself completely.

Chen Ji felt his mind explode, countless pieces of information flooding into his consciousness like a torrent—this was the complete method to break the 'Heavenly Fate Shackles,' the shocking secret left behind by the original master of the Tianji Record.

However, the price was clearly branded within the text:

"To break the shackles, one must trade life for life. The record-holder's life, in exchange for the bound one's fate. Heavenly Fate Value... drops to zero."

dialogue.content:
(His pupils contracting sharply, waves of shock crashing in his heart) Trade life for life... Heavenly Fate Value drops to zero... In other words, to free Chen Nian from the shackles, the price is my own life?

(Smiring coldly) Fine scheme. Generation after generation of Tianji Record masters... were probably driven mad by this price, weren't they?"

text.content:
"However, before he could fully process this information, at the very bottom of the fourth page of the Tianji Record, a line of extremely faint small characters slowly appeared—that was something Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned.

"There is another shortcut: using the blood of the Heavenly Fate Key to sacrifice to heaven can divert the cost. Heavenly Fate Value needs only three hundred points, and the Key shall fall into eternal slumber."

Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly."

"Two paths lay before him.

The first was to trade life for life, saving Chen Nian at the cost of himself—this ran counter to his grand scheme of manipulating the world and eventually overturning the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

The second was to use Chen Nian as sacrifice, trading his sister's eternal sleep for his own continued existence—but was that still the Chen Ji who would dare to confront the entire cultivation world for his sister's sake?

Above, everyone in the hall gazed at the light from his chest in fear and amazement. None knew that this 'waste' was undergoing what kind of cruel choice."

choice.prompt: "The fourth page of the Tianji Record manifested, and Chen Ji faces a crossroads of fate. Now that everyone in the hall watches in shock and curiosity, how should he respond?"

choices.text: "Retreat to advance, putting on an act of being counteracted by the treasure."
choices.description: "Pretend to be eroded by the Tianji Record, fall into a coma, and use the opportunity to escape and strategize. Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master is watching eagerly—this is an extremely unfavorable time to expose his trump cards."
choices.visible_cost: "Risk of missing the chance to slip away in the chaos."
choices.visible_reward: "Protect the secret of the Tianji Record, buy time."
choices.risk_hint: "Any slight flaw in acting will arouse suspicion."

text.content:
"Chen Ji's eyes rolled back, and he spat a mouthful of blood, his entire body toppling backward stiffly.

"Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao reacted first, darting to his side and catching him.

The light from the Tianji Record immediately dimmed, as if it were merely a fleeting, fleeting illusion. Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master furrowed his brow, his gaze sinisterly fixed on the unconscious Chen Ji, his thoughts unreadable."

choices.text: "Use the momentum to counterattack, intimidating all the petty people present."
choices.description: "Since it's already exposed, might as well take this opportunity to establish dominance. Let everyone present witness the power of the Tianji Record, paving the way for future schemes."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely exposing the existence of the Tianji Record, drawing more covetous eyes."
choices.visible_reward: "Intimidate Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master, reputation greatly increased."
choices.risk_hint: "Risk of drawing the attention of the Heavenly Dao's Eye."

text.content:
"Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, golden light blazing in both eyes.

An invisible pressure erupted from within him, sweeping across the entire hall. Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master's face contorted drastically as he retreated three steps—that was the aura of Heavenly Dao's laws, a power beyond the mortal realm.

"Wh-what is this thing!"

Chen Ji rose slowly, a mocking curve creeping across his lips: "Sect Master wasn't trying to see the power in my hands just now? Now... is it clear enough?"

choices.text: "Seek help from Su Qingyao, testing her attitude."
choices.description: "Su Qingyao is the only one who sensed something off about him—perhaps he could take this chance to test whether she is trustworthy,争取一个潜在盟友。
choices.visible_cost: "Exposing part of the secret, she might press for more details."
choices.visible_reward: "Deepen the relationship with Su Qingyao, might gain an ally."
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao is extremely suspicious, won't be easily convinced."

text.content:
"Chen Ji stumbled forward, 'casually' drawing near Su Qingyao.

"Senior Sister Su..." His voice was for her ears alone, carrying a hint of genuine weariness, "I need your help. This is a long story, but... can I trust you?"

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted slightly. As the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, she had seen countless deceptions, but the complex emotions in Chen Ji's eyes at this moment made her feel for the first time—perhaps this person truly was opening his heart to her."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶开始真正关注陈机的处境

text.content:
"Just then, a sudden change occurred.

Above the hall's dome, a pair of eyes silently opened.

These were no ordinary eyes—no whites, no pupils, only a chaotic void, yet emanating an aura that made souls tremble. Everyone froze in place, unable to move, even a figure like Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master revealing a look of terror."

dialogue.content:
(The Heavenly Dao's Eye slowly rotating, as if examining something)

Interesting...

(A voice echoed in the void, directly appearing in everyone's mind) The new master of the Tianji Record is far more interesting than those incompetent predecessors of yours... Scheming three sects, calculating hearts and minds, even daring to peer into this one's existence...

(The voice carried a hint of amusement) But do you know... everything about you... is under this one's gaze?

text.content:
"Chen Ji's blood seemed to freeze.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye—that ultimate existence he had thought was merely legend, now gazed down upon him from above. Like a chess player, looking down at the pieces on the board who thought themselves clever.

He had schemed across the world, leaving nothing to chance, believing he was weaving a game to overturn the heavens from the shadows.

But only now did he understand—he may have been, from the very beginning, merely a piece on someone else's chessboard."

dialogue.content:
(Forcing down the tidal waves in his heart, a smile actually blooming on his face)

The Heavenly Dao's Eye? Hmph... I thought you would have noticed me sooner.

(Gazing directly into those void eyes) Since you enjoy watching the show so much, I have to ask—how do you think my performance is going?"

text.content:
"The Heavenly Dao's Eye fell silent for a moment.

A pin drop could be heard in the hall, everyone waiting for this existence beyond mortal comprehension to respond. Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master had cold sweat dripping down his forehead—he never imagined he would one day witness such a being with his own eyes.

"Interesting."

That void voice rang out once more, this time carrying something like... appreciation?

"Every previous Tianji Record master, either went mad, surrendered, or perished. You are the first... to dare gaze directly at this one."

choice.prompt: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye personally manifested—this was a variable Chen Ji never anticipated. Faced with this existence transcending all else, what choice should he make?"

choices.text: "Play along pretentiously, feigning submission to buy time to breathe."
choices.description: "Kowtowing to the Heavenly Dao's Eye isn't shameful—living to fight another day is what matters. Stabilize this terrifying existence first, seek a method to break the situation later."
choices.visible_cost: "Might be seen as weak—how will everyone present view him?"
choices.visible_reward: "Buy time, no need to directly confront the Heavenly Dao's Eye."
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye sees through everything—acting may be ineffective."

text.content:
"Chen Ji drew a deep breath, then slowly knelt.

"This junior was presumptuous, not knowing the heights of heaven." His voice was steady, carrying just the right amount of reverence, "Heavenly Dao's Eye above, this junior merely wishes to seek a sliver of hope for my sister—I meant no offense."

The Heavenly Dao's Eye seemed unsurprised by his submission, the void eyes narrowing slightly: "Seeking your sister? Hah... you are rather candid. This one grants you seven days—when the time comes, this one shall personally come to claim what belongs to this one."

choices.description: "Since we've come this far, retreat will only make it despise you more. Might as well ask clearly—what exactly does it want?"
choices.visible_cost: "Risk of thoroughly angering the Heavenly Dao's Eye, consequences unpredictable."
choices.visible_reward: "Might obtain crucial information, understanding one's predicament."
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye is unpredictable in its joys and angers—might mete out punishment on the spot."

text.content:
"Chen Ji straightened his body, gazing directly into those void eyes.

"You say I am under your gaze—then I want to know, what are you waiting for?" His voice was not loud, yet it clearly echoed through the hall, "Every previous Tianji Record master, either went mad, surrendered, or perished... Are you waiting for me to become one of them?"

The Heavenly Dao's Eye fell into a long silence.

"...You truly are different." That voice carried a depth of meaning, "Within seven days, if you can break the局, this one shall acknowledge you—as the most promising piece... on this one's chessboard."

choices.text: "Activate the power of the Tianji Record's fourth page to counterattack."
choices.description: "Since the fourth page of the Tianji Record has manifested, perhaps it conceals power capable of opposing the Heavenly Dao's Eye. Go all in—maybe we can fight for a sliver of hope."
choices.visible_cost: "Consumes a massive amount of Heavenly Fate Value, cost unknown."
choices.visible_reward: "Might intimidate the Heavenly Dao's Eye, buying time."
choices.risk_hint: "Risk of causing the Tianji Record to go out of control, or bringing about greater disaster."

text.content:
"Chen Ji abruptly channeled the fourth page of the Tianji Record.

Golden characters erupted from within him, gathering before him into a barrier, directly facing the Heavenly Dao's Eye's pressure. In that instant, the entire hall shook violently under this clash of powers.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye revealed... surprise?

"This power..." that void voice rarely carried a hint of fluctuation, "You dare to wield it before this one?"

"Didn't you enjoy watching the show?" Chen Ji grinned, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth, "Then watch this show—is it exciting enough!"

flags_set: 天机录第四页力量已动用

text.content:
"The Heavenly Dao's Eye slowly closed, vanishing into the void.

That suffocating pressure also dissipated, and the people in the hall collapsed in relief. Su Qingyao supported the unsteady Chen Ji, her eyes filled with shock and complex emotions.

"You..." She started to speak, then stopped, finally just sighing, "Just who exactly are you?"

Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze pierced through the hall, looking toward the distant horizon—that was the direction where Chen Nian resided.

Seven days.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye had given him seven days.

Was this a death countdown, or an opportunity to break the局?"

"Meanwhile, in the depths of the ancient ruins, the golden characters on the stone wall before Chen Nian slowly faded.

She reached out, wanting to grasp something, but only touched cold stone.

"Brother..." Her voice carried a sob, "Did you see it? That choice... you can't choose the second path! I won't let you die for me!"

But her cries could reach no one's ears.

The Holy Sect's guards were approaching—she had to record all the remaining text on the stone wall before they arrived—that was crucial information her brother might need.

She would not let her brother face all of this alone."

"Inside the Tianqing Sect Council Hall, everyone gradually came back to their senses.

Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master's expression could no longer be described as gloomy—it had gone far beyond that. He had witnessed the existence of the Heavenly Dao's Eye with his own eyes, watched that waste servant converse and even clash with such a being.

What did that mean? It meant he had underestimated Chen Ji from the very beginning.

"Anyone who dares leak a single word of today's events—" His voice was dark, but when he met Chen Ji's calm gaze, he forcibly swallowed his words."

"Chen Ji rose slowly, brushing dust from his robes that wasn't there.

"Sect Master," his voice was neither humble nor assertive, even carrying a hint of indolence, "Today I have caused much offense, I hope you'll forgive me. However..."

He turned his head, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips:

"You should consider yourself fortunate—I don't consider you worthy of being my opponent. Otherwise—"

He didn't finish, but that unfinished implication made Xuanwu Sect's Sect Master's face turn ashen, yet he had no way to refute it."

"Outside the hall, the night wind cut like a blade.

Chen Ji stood alone at the Cliff Edge, gazing at the dawning pale white sky on the horizon. The appearance of the Heavenly Dao's Eye had disrupted all his schemes, yet it also showed him one thing—

He had thought himself the Chess Player, but was merely the most conspicuous piece on the chessboard.

But so what?

From waste servant to master schemer, from obtaining the Tianji Record Fragment to confronting the Heavenly Dao's Eye... Chen Ji was never one to accept fate.

The seven-day deadline, the opportunity to break the局.

He would make those eyes beyond Heavenly Dao understand—the chess game of Chen Ji is one even Heaven itself dares not despise."
